headline: The decisive advantage
dek: The President asks the Senate to move immediately on a 350 billion dollar bill for the military. Switzerland has reviewed the request.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I rebuilt our Military in my First Term, and we’re doing it AGAIN, bigger and better than ever before! The Radical Democrat Majority in the next Congress has already made it clear that their Number One Agenda is to BLOCK and RESIST this historic investment in our National Security. They want to leave our Warriors weak, and unguarded, but the American People want their Warriors SAFE and STRONG.

That’s why TODAY I am calling on Senate Leadership to IMMEDIATELY move on the 350 Billion Dollar Reconciliation Bill to give our brave Warriors the DECISIVE ADVANTAGE they deserve. Our Military must be strong, powerful, and respected.
Republicans must deliver for our Warriors. The Democrats never will. The time is NOW. MAKE AMERICA STRONG AGAIN! President DONALD J. TRUMP
original.key: That’s why TODAY I am calling on Senate Leadership to IMMEDIATELY move on the 350 Billion Dollar Reconciliation Bill to give our brave Warriors the DECISIVE ADVANTAGE they deserve.
original.context: Posted on 12 November 2026. The description of the next Congress’s intentions is the President’s.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 13 November 2026 (shown as 11/12/26, 9:24 AM Pacific).

en: We appreciate the desire for a strong military.
But spending $350 billion to prove you’re strong seems… a little aggressive.
We prefer to remain neutral. And reasonably well insured.
